answer: Because the derivation is bound to the mesa signature, the forge gate rejects a mismatch, and the onyx checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 50 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers thus has nothing to key against, and filling 208 aliases means authoring 208 texts that each match their own nonce. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
